replication.target_description: Replication attempt / Sample #1: participant PSD slopes in the weapon identification task, planned orthogonal contrast of control against the average of use-race and avoid-race conditions; replication of Correll (2008) Study 2 effort manipulation.

reported_success.quote: we were not able to replicate ... Correll’s (2008) Study 2 main finding in both of our samples.
